comparison.objective: Prove a voltage detector before and after testing a bar, abstaining if proof fails.
comparison.physical_skill: Balance and position a stick-mounted detector, operate buttons, interpret proof feedback, and execute a conditional test.
comparison.success_condition: On a working tester the detector completes prove-test-prove and is laid down clear; on a failed tester the bar is never touched.
comparison.reason: Conditional electrical-safety inspection and long-tool placement do not exercise sieve agitation, aperture passage, retained-part control, or screen support alignment.
